opening: Something in you called you here. Maybe it was the land, acres of sacred Costa Rican jungle, ocean-kissed and alive with possibility. Maybe it was the vision of a village where all beings belong and thrive. Maybe it was simply the feeling that the world you want to live in needs to be built.
governance: How residents govern themselves, and how we steward this land together, will be co-created by the first residents. Nothing here is handed down. Once we've sold 33 lots, we'll convene a governance council to structure this together. You're not joining a finished system; you're helping write it.
